info.description: Comprehensive Purchase Management API for Branch Managers - Handles order creation, tracking, receiving goods, and return management

query.description: Order type: all, direct_supplier, via_purchasing_officer, internal_transfer
Date range: last_24h, last_7d, last_30d, custom

Compare prices for an item across Direct Supplier, Via PO, and Internal Transfer
